item: M-C T-04 tampered graph evidence fingerprint refusal

build.notes: Production build compiled, checked lint/types, and generated all 62 static pages. Existing caniuse-lite and edge-runtime static-generation warnings were reported.

unit_test.assertion: An AVAILABLE response with differing expected and observed SHA-256 values is rejected as an invalid artifact fingerprint.

browser_test.command: $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_EXPLORER_ENABLED='true'; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_EVIDENCE_ENABLED='true'; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_RESEARCH_ENABLED='false'; $env:PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH='C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; npx playwright test --config=playwright.e2e.config.ts --headed --timeout=120000 --grep 'graph search and ingredient inspection preserve evidence labels'
assertions: A mismatched expected/observed fingerprint for an AVAILABLE evidence response renders the unavailable message.
The evidence panel displays neither the manifest fingerprint nor a decision for the rejected response.
browser_test.api_mode: Local route fixtures; this browser test does not call a live evidence service.

frontend.format_and_lint: Prettier, ESLint, and the commit lint hook passed.

acceptance_limit: These checks validate FE evidence-fingerprint refusal and the backend verified-bundle loader separately. The FE graph map still reads the bounded legacy Knowledge API, and the accepted graph-product artifact/route is absent. The complete artifact-backed Explorer refusal condition in T-04 remains open.
